slides.label: What Noisia is
slides.title: A context-driven social intelligence **partner**
slides.lead: We help brands understand what people do, why they do it and what it means for the business. Our analysts turn social conversation into clear, decision-ready intelligence.

pillars.title: Listen to the market
pillars.text: Continuous monitoring of your brand, your competitors and your category.

pillars.title: Understand the why
pillars.text: Interpretation with your context on top of the data.

pillars.title: Answer the decision
pillars.text: In-depth studies to launch, enter, defend, optimize or innovate.

pillars.title: Back it with evidence
pillars.text: Every finding points to real, traceable conversation you can see.

slides.notes: Walk the diagram left to right: we listen to what people already say, separate signal from noise and group it, answer the decision with a priority, and every finding points to the original conversation. We do not sell software: we deliver the reading.
